description: This file declares the interface for eMMC diagnostic APIs within the STBService component, including class definitions, method signatures, and constants related to eMMC storage management.

classes.name: hostIf_STBServiceXeMMC
classes.description: A class providing interface methods for eMMC management and diagnostics, implemented as a singleton.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the class.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Destroys the singleton instance of the class.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get messages for the eMMC device.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles set messages for the eMMC device.

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.description: Retrieves the capacity of the eMMC device.

methods.name: getLifeElapsedA
methods.description: Retrieves the life elapsed metric A.

methods.name: getLifeElapsedB
methods.description: Retrieves the life elapsed metric B.

methods.name: getLifeElapsed
methods.description: Retrieves the life elapsed metric based on specified type.

methods.name: getLotID
methods.description: Retrieves the lot ID of the eMMC.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves the manufacturer information.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the model information.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the device is read-only.

methods.name: getSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number.

methods.name: getTSBQualified
methods.description: Checks if the device is TSB qualified.

methods.name: getPreEOLStateSystem
methods.description: Gets the pre-end-of-life state for the system.

methods.name: getPreEOLStateEUDA
methods.description: Gets the pre-end-of-life state for EUDA.

methods.name: getPreEOLStateMLC
methods.description: Gets the pre-end-of-life state for MLC.

methods.name: getPreEOLState
methods.description: Gets the pre-end-of-life state based on specific type.

methods.name: getFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version.

methods.name: getDeviceReport
methods.description: Gets the device report information.
